signature.name: VTask.embeddingsMatrixReindex
signature.type: {κ : Type w} -> (A : Type u) -> {B : Type v} -> (C : Type z) -> [CommRing A] -> [CommRing B] -> [Algebra A B] -> [CommRing C] -> [Algebra A C] -> (b : κ → B) -> (e : κ ≃ (B →ₐ[A] C)) -> Matrix κ κ C

conventions.statement: Column index j selects the embedding e(j) : B →ₐ[A] C, so the (i, j)-entry is e(j)(b(i)).
conventions.note: The equivalence e is applied in the forward direction for columns.

conventions.statement: When κ is the empty type, the result is the unique 0×0 matrix, which is valid and contains no entries.
conventions.note: The definition is total and produces a well-typed value even when κ is empty.

conventions.statement: When b is the zero map, every entry of the resulting matrix is 0, since A-algebra homomorphisms preserve 0.
conventions.note: This is a consequence of the algebraic structure, not a special case in the definition.

facts.statement: ∀ {κ : Type*} (A : Type*) {B : Type*} (C : Type*) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] (b : κ → B) (e : κ ≃ (B →ₐ[A] C)), ∀ i j : κ, VTask.embeddingsMatrixReindex A C b e i j ∈ (Set.univ : Set C)
